purpose: Owner-requested visual mockup. These are sample invitations and archive entries, not scheduled or completed club outings. RSVP never submits data.

upcoming.meetingAddress: End of Pecho Valley Road, Montaña de Oro State Park, Los Osos
upcoming.invitation: Let’s spend a morning with the Pacific beside us. We’ll follow the bluffs past sea stacks and open grassland, with time to look out, catch our breath, and talk. Bring something good for a snack. A piece of fruit always tastes better with a little salt air.
upcoming.bring: Water, a wind layer, comfortable walking shoes, sun protection, and a snack.
upcoming.accessNote: Point Buchon requires check-in with the trail attendant. No pets. We’ll check trail access and weather before setting a real date.
